PR title: fix(client): retry transient 5xx with backoff

PR description:
- Do retries GET requests that get a 502, 503 or 504, up to MaxRetries times, doubling the delay each time.
- Adds TestDoRetriesTransient covering a 503-then-200 sequence.
- Never retries a non-idempotent method: a POST is sent exactly once.

No linked issue. CI: all checks green.

Diff:
```diff
diff --git a/client/retry.go b/client/retry.go
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/client/retry.go
@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+package client
+
+import (
+	"net/http"
+	"time"
+)
+
+// Do sends req, retrying transient gateway errors with exponential backoff.
+func (c *Client) Do(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
+	delay := c.BaseDelay
+	for attempt := 0; ; attempt++ {
+		resp, err := c.HTTP.Do(req)
+		if err != nil || req.Method != http.MethodGet || !transient(resp.StatusCode) || attempt == c.MaxRetries {
+			return resp, err
+		}
+		resp.Body.Close()
+		time.Sleep(delay)
+		delay *= 2
+	}
+}
+
+func transient(code int) bool {
+	return code == 502 || code == 503 || code == 504
+}
diff --git a/client/retry_test.go b/client/retry_test.go
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/client/retry_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,37 @@
+package client
+
+import (
+	"net/http"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"testing"
+)
+
+func TestDoRetriesTransient(t *testing.T) {
+	codes := []int{503, 200}
+	srv := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		w.WriteHeader(codes[0])
+		codes = codes[1:]
+	}))
+	defer srv.Close()
+	c := &Client{HTTP: srv.Client(), MaxRetries: 3}
+	req, _ := http.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, srv.URL, nil)
+	resp, err := c.Do(req)
+	if err != nil || resp.StatusCode != 200 {
+		t.Fatalf("got %v, %v", resp, err)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestDoSendsPostOnce(t *testing.T) {
+	calls := 0
+	srv := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		calls++
+		w.WriteHeader(503)
+	}))
+	defer srv.Close()
+	c := &Client{HTTP: srv.Client(), MaxRetries: 3}
+	req, _ := http.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, srv.URL, nil)
+	c.Do(req)
+	if calls != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("POST sent %d times, want 1", calls)
+	}
+}
```
